difficulty.notes: React/webpack split chunks (.cache_chunks). 614.js is the phone-login chunk: anchor _ is the useCallback submit handler that encrypts password inline via imported helpers G (cipher) and d (hash) keyed off the mobile and a dnGetter nonce. Sibling renders N (LoginByGZH) and ee (LoginModal) are decoys. G/d/F are imported from commons.js (not pinned).

task_contract.anchor_definition: _: the phone-login submit handler that builds the encrypted data field inline and posts it; not sibling login renders (N/ee) or imported cipher/hash helpers.

behavior_category.subtype: cipher over nonce+password with a mobile-derived key, inline in the submit handler
behavior_category.recompute_check: The key/nonce derive from F.dnGetter() (a per-request value); the data ciphertext is not reproducible offline to a fixed value.

near_categories.why_not: A single data field carries the encrypted credential; the rest of the request is plain (mobile, time).
The value derives from password+mobile+nonce, not device/browser signals.

evidence: Minified React chunk; the handler is an anonymous useCallback bound to _ and the cipher/hash are single-letter imports G/d.
The chunk contains several login-component renders (phone, GZH, modal, container); only the phone handler builds the encrypted data.
Key derivation (d), cipher (G) and nonce (F.dnGetter) are imported from commons.js, so the value construction is split across chunks.

question_direction.notes: The visible question asks for the complete function whose own body reads password/mobile, derives a key, runs the cipher and submits the phone-login request; it also excludes imported helpers and sibling login components, so it points to _.
